description: Signed-in policies in public that carry no request-tenant condition, or that reach their tenant through a parent row, each reviewed, pinned to its deparsed text, its command, its sorted roles and whether it is permissive, and named with the package that ends it. The catalog gate (scripts/verify/tenant-rls-catalog.mjs) fails any other signed-in policy of a tenant table without the condition, any signed-in policy that is not listed here on a table that reaches its tenant through a parent (PARENT_SCOPED_POLICY_NOT_PINNED), a listed policy whose text, command, roles or kind changes (POLICY_EXCEPTION_CHANGED) and a listed policy that is gone (POLICY_EXCEPTION_STALE). See docs/security/tenant-policy-activation-review.md, section 3, the coordinator's rulings of 19 November 2026 on its questions 3 and 4, and the council's R3.

entries.using: (( SELECT authz.is_super_admin() AS is_super_admin) OR (((tenant_id IS NULL) OR (tenant_id = ( SELECT authz.current_tenant_id() AS current_tenant_id))) AND (( SELECT authz.current_tenant_id() AS current_tenant_id) IS NOT NULL)))
entries.reason: It carries the tenant condition and also admits the global rows (tenant_id IS NULL), which belong to no tenant, to a member of the active tenant: a donor row and a missionary row still read field_policies.
entries.ends: WP2c removes its super-admin branch; the global rows are permanent

Approved, published, public posts whose worker is not withheld, TO anon, read with no header by the public site until WP7's third pull request ends anonymous reads; a signed-in caller reads posts through "posts tenant read" only (AL-2680, WP7 pull request 1, invariant 2).

The caller's own profile, read with no tenant header by sign-in, the session helpers and the health probe. The row is the person's, not a tenant's (plan 5.1: a profile is readable by its owner only). Since AL-2678 (WP5 part 1, D-76, W5-R3) a profile's user_id equals its id, by NOT NULL and a check, so the policy matches user_id alone.
entries.ends: WP5, which drops profiles.tenant_id, after which profiles is no longer a tenant table
